extraMeanings.exampleEn: It is imperative that we act quickly before the situation gets worse.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Durum daha kötüye gitmeden hızlı hareket etmemiz şarttır.

extraMeanings.en: a tool or instrument used for a particular task
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The farmer kept his gardening implements in the old shed.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çiftçi bahçe aletlerini eski kulübede saklardı.

extraMeanings.tr: külfet olmak, rahatsızlık vermek, yük olmak
extraMeanings.en: to unfairly force someone to do something or take advantage of them
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I don't want to impose on you, but could I stay for one more night?
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sana yük olmak istemiyorum ama bir gece daha kalabilir miyim?

extraMeanings.tr: taklit sanatçısı, ünlüleri taklit eden komedyen
extraMeanings.en: an entertainer who imitates the voices and behavior of famous people
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The impressionist did a hilarious version of the president's speech.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Taklit sanatçısı başkanın konuşmasının çok komik bir versiyonunu yaptı.

extraMeanings.en: to feel or make someone feel willing to do something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I'm inclined to agree with you on this matter.

extraMeanings.en: a system of numbers used to compare values or measure economic change
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The stock market index fell sharply after the announcement.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Borsa endeksi açıklamadan sonra keskin bir şekilde düştü.

extraMeanings.en: the process of reaching a general conclusion from particular facts
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Scientists often use induction to form theories from repeated observations.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bilim insanları tekrarlanan gözlemlerden teori oluşturmak için sık sık tümevarımı kullanır.

extraMeanings.en: someone who has a lower position or rank than another
extraMeanings.exampleEn: A good manager treats his inferiors with respect.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İyi bir yönetici astlarına saygıyla davranır.

extraMeanings.en: to make something seem larger or more important than it really is
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He tends to inflate his own achievements when talking to strangers.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yabancılarla konuşurken kendi başarılarını abartma eğilimindedir.

extraMeanings.tr: inisiyatif; harekete geçme yeteneği ve isteği
extraMeanings.en: the ability to act and make decisions on your own without being told
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She showed great initiative by solving the problem before anyone asked.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kimse istemeden sorunu çözerek büyük inisiyatif gösterdi.

extraMeanings.en: to receive a situation or problem from a previous person or period
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The new government inherited a huge national debt.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yeni hükümet büyük bir ulusal borç devraldı.

extraMeanings.en: the first letter of a person's name
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Please sign your initials at the bottom of each page.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Lütfen her sayfanın altına baş harflerinizi atın.

extraMeanings.en: a short signal or wave of energy passing along a nerve or wire
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Nerve cells carry electrical impulses to the brain.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sinir hücreleri beyne elektriksel uyarılar taşır.

extraMeanings.en: the inner part or surface of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The inside of the box was lined with soft velvet.

extraMeanings.en: in or into a building or enclosed space
extraMeanings.exampleEn: It started to rain, so we went inside.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yağmur başladı, biz de içeri girdik.

extraMeanings.en: to spread a feeling or attitude to other people
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Her enthusiasm quickly infected the whole team.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Onun coşkusu tüm takıma hızla bulaştı.
